correctness.rationale: PASS: The standard integral DGA support decomposition for the complex moment-angle pair identifies each nonempty support I with shifted reduced cochains of P_n[I]. Since each induced graph is a forest, only H~0 occurs, represented by Z^{c(I)}/Z·(1,...,1), torsion-free. The coordinate-reversal action includes the sign of the ordered support permutation. For a symmetric support with a fixed central component, the quotient component lattice has only regular Z[C2] blocks; otherwise paired components give h−1 regular blocks and one sign line, with determinant twist (−1)^{k/2}. Counting such supports gives N_(n,k) and counting induced edges gives b_(n,k); remaining rank R=(b−N)/2. Finite-group rational averaging gives quotient ranks. Independently enumerated all supports for 3≤n≤11, confirming ranks, fixed-support signed trace and exceptional multiplicities, but all-n proof rests on the explicit integral lattices.
